record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PSYSHOCK: Psyduck (1 star) and Golduck (2 stars); both range 1, maxPP 100, passive PSYDUCK. The strategy is shared; unit differences are the star index into the PP table. Units not listed are not covered.
record.summary: Needs a target (inherited requiresTarget = true); the default ability animation is suppressed (preventDefaultAnim true). Requested ppBurn = table[stars-1] x (1 + AP/100) with table 20 / 40 / 80 / 160 (160 fallback), not rounded, i.e. 20 (Psyduck) / 40 (Golduck) at AP 0. ppStolen = min(target.pp, ppBurn) and extraPP = ppBurn - ppStolen. The strategy then (1) asks the target to lose ppStolen PP through addPP(-ppStolen, caster, 0, false), (2) gives the caster a shield of the full ppBurn through addShield(ppBurn, caster, 0, false) - not just the stolen part, and (3) if extraPP > 0, deals extraPP as SPECIAL damage to the target through handleSpecialDamage with the cast's crit flag and apBoost false (AP is already inside ppBurn). Requested, downstream and stored amounts differ: addPP rounds -ppStolen and may be dropped (status.tree, resurrecting) or turned positive (Twist Band on the target; a positive value is then also subject to silence / protect / NO_PP_GAIN); addShield first applies Big Eater Belt (x1.25, rounded down) on the caster, then rounds, halves it if the caster is enraged, and needs the caster alive; the damage is divided by the target's special defence, rounded up with a minimum of 1 and takes the shield first.

targeting.who: the cast target (PP loss and leftover damage); the caster itself (shield)
targeting.note: Single target. Nothing is done to any other unit.

declaredRaw.label: raw ppBurn base per star (before the AP factor)

effects.scaling: requested ppBurn = table[stars-1] x (1 + AP/100), unrounded; ppStolen = min(target.pp, ppBurn). The addPP call then uses apBoost 0 and crit false, so the AP and crit factors are not applied a second time.
effects.resolution: addPP(-ppStolen): value = Math.round(-ppStolen x 1 x 1 x 1) (fatigue only halves positive requests, so it does not apply); Twist Band on the target flips the value to positive; a negative value is dropped while the target has status.tree or is resurrecting; the final pp = clamp(pp + value, 0, 2 x maxPP - 1). Status.protect does not block a negative value (it blocks positive PP gain; section J3). Applied = the rounded value when not dropped; with a fractional ppBurn the rounding means the target loses the rounded amount while the shield and extraPP use the unrounded number. Twist Band reverses the effect into a PP gain for the target if it is not silenced, protected or under NO_PP_GAIN.

declaredRaw.label: requested shield = ppBurn (full, including the part that exceeds the target's PP)

effects.scaling: requested = table[stars-1] x (1 + AP/100) at AP 0 shown as the per-unit raw values; downstream: Big Eater Belt on the caster multiplies a positive value by 1.25 rounded down (before the state step); addShield then uses apBoost 0 (no second AP factor), crit false, halves a positive value when the caster is enraged, and rounds with Math.round.
effects.resolution: applied only if the caster's hp > 0; shield = max(0, shield + value); caster.shieldDone grows by the shield. The amount does not depend on how much PP the target had (ppBurn, not ppStolen). Requested = ppBurn; downstream request = after Big Eater Belt; stored change = after the enraged halving and rounding.

effects.target: the cast target, only when extraPP > 0

declaredRaw.label: requested damage = ppBurn - ppStolen (the part of the burn that the target's PP could not cover)

effects.scaling: requested = extraPP (AP already inside ppBurn, apBoost false so no second AP factor); handleSpecialDamage then multiplies by 2 once with DOUBLE_DAMAGE, by 1.2 with STRANGE_STEAM_BOARD_EFFECT and, on a crit (needs ABILITY_CRIT; canCritByDefault false), by 1 + (critPower - 1) x the target's crit reduction factor (Rocky Helmet / Black Augurite). The same crit flag is not applied to the PP loss or the shield.
effects.resolution: applied = requested after those multipliers; PokemonState.handleDamage divides by (1 + ARMOR_FACTOR x speDef), rounds up with a minimum of 1 and lets the target's shield absorb first. takenDamage (not stored by this strategy) = shield damage + HP damage capped at current HP; 0 if the target is protected / skydiving / Magic Bounce. A Magic Bounce target also queues a bounce. If the target has at least ppBurn PP no damage is requested at all.

shields.scaling: Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down on the caster; enraged halves; rounded; no AP factor applied twice

starBehavior.note: The table is indexed by the casting entity's stars. 80 / 160 are not reached by the listed units at their factory star counts. Whether other mechanics change a unit's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: None beyond the inherited requirement that the unit has a target in range to cast.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state. Each cast recomputes ppBurn from the caster's current AP; shields from earlier casts stack on the caster's shield value.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 20 / 40 PP (PSYDUCK / GOLDUCK) before the AP factor. Requested ppBurn = raw x (1 + AP/100), unrounded. ppStolen = min(target PP, ppBurn). Applied PP change = Math.round(-ppStolen) unless dropped, flipped by Twist Band or blocked by tree / resurrecting. Shield requested = ppBurn; downstream request after Big Eater Belt; stored after enraged halving and rounding. Damage requested = ppBurn - ppStolen; applied after multipliers; takenDamage = shield part + HP part.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, silence, target acquisition for a requiresTarget ability) - only the castAbility gate was read

The PSYDUCK passive: it was located only at the two read sites (onHit 10% self-confusion when hit, +100 AP in triggerConfusion); whether further handlers exist outside app/ lines searched by name was not established, and its AP gain feeds ppBurn via the (1 + AP/100) factor
Which targets can hold PP at all (units with maxPP and NO_PP_GAIN / tree interactions) was not examined beyond addPP's guards
unresolved: Whether the two units reach a different star count than the factory value (Psyduck evolves to Golduck) was not examined
Magic Bounce reflection is mentioned from the read lines 360-396 of handleSpecialDamage only; the bounce damage was not traced further
No routing uncertainties were queued for this record
